settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public host name where ARSnova is reachable. It must resolve to this server.
settings.admin_email_helper: E-mail of an already registered ARSnova user to grant administrator rights. Register the account first, then enter it here.
settings.resources_hint: ARSnova runs 12 containers, five of them Java services. Plan at least 2 GB of free RAM for the module alone (about 1.7 GB measured at rest); Particify recommends 4 CPU cores and 8 GB RAM for production use. With less, the services start slowly and may restart a few times.
settings.allow_registration_off_hint: New sign-ups from the login page are blocked (default of a new installation). Existing accounts and directory users can still log in. Switch it on to let people without a directory account register themselves.
settings.allow_registration_on_hint: Anyone who can open ARSnova can create an account. Switch it off if the host is reachable from the internet and only directory users should log in.
settings.smtp_host_helper: Used only when no cluster smarthost is configured. ARSnova supports a plain relay on port 25 without authentication.
settings.public_url_desc: ARSnova is reachable at {url}. Users log in with a directory account or, when self-registration is on, register themselves; the verification e-mail must be delivered (or read the code from the logs when no relay is set).
settings.https_hint: Behind a cross-node HTTPS gateway or TLS terminator, enable "Redirect HTTP to HTTPS" so links and tokens use the https scheme.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
settings.ldap_title_helper: Name of the login button for directory accounts, e.g. the name of your organisation.
settings.ldap_limits: ARSnova connects with ldaps:// or ldap:// (no StartTLS). A group restriction needs Active Directory or Samba; OpenLDAP groups cannot be checked. Users log in with the button above the e-mail login.
settings.start_tls_unsupported: ARSnova does not support StartTLS: use an ldaps:// URL
settings.group_needs_ad: A group restriction needs Active Directory or Samba; leave the group empty for OpenLDAP
settings.ldap_value_invalid: Line breaks, braces and "${" are not allowed here

ldap_login.no_domains: This cluster has no user domain yet. Add one in Domains and users, or enter an LDAP server.
ldap_login.group_helper: Only members of this group may log in (nested groups count). Empty: every user of the domain.
ldap_login.group_custom_helper: Group name or DN; only its members may log in. Empty: every user found under the base DN.
ldap_login.custom_intro: Only needed for a directory that is not a user domain of this cluster. NS8 can also add an external AD/LDAP as a user domain (Domains and users): then it shows up above and no credentials are stored here.
ldap_login.tls_verify_off: The certificate is not checked: someone in the network path could read the passwords. Only for tests or a trusted network.
ldap_login.bind_password_helper: Password of the service account; stored outside the module environment.
ldap_login.secret_is_set: A password is stored — leave blank to keep it.
ldap_login.ldap_domain_unknown: This user domain does not exist in the cluster
ldap_login.start_tls_with_ldaps: StartTLS is only for ldap:// URLs
